```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for total spending
data['Total_Spending'] = (data['MntWines'] + data['MntFruits'] + data['MntMeatProducts'] +
                          data['MntFishProducts'] + data['MntSweetProducts'] + data['MntGoldProds'])

# Create a new column for total children
data['Total_Children'] = data['Kidhome'] + data['Teenhome']

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Education', size='Total_Children',
                          sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6, palette='viridis', data=data)

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Customer Spending vs Income', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)

# Customize the legend
handles, labels = scatter.get_legend_handles_labels()
scatter.legend(handles=handles[1:], labels=labels[1:], title="Education and Children", bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
